description: This file defines the Stream class implementing the StreamInterface for PSR-7 HTTP message streams, including methods for stream management, reading, writing, seeking, and metadata handling.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Implementation of PSR-7 StreamInterface for managing PHP streams with additional utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream object with a resource, setting seekable, readable, and writable flags.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Stream instance from a string, resource, or existing StreamInterface.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Automatically closes the stream when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the resource from the stream object, resetting internal state.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI metadata of the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining contents of the stream.
